name: Reyana
description: Auriok woman on New Phyrexia, rearguard and firebird keeper in Neyali's resistance cell, who let herself become compleated.

description_citations.text: "Reyana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Otharri screams a warning and Neyali realizes Reyana, the rear guard, is missing and races back.
timeline.quote: Neyali launched into motion before any of her cohorts could answer

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Neyali finds Reyana cornered by a compleated Auriok aspirant who offers to make her perfect; Reyana is distraught and has dropped her weapons.
timeline.quote: You are finally ready to be made perfect,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Reyana reveals the aspirant was her mother.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: In the rookery, Reyana finds her clutch dead and confesses she once wished her mother dead and asks, what if Phyrexia is right?

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Neyali promises to stay by Reyana's side, but Reyana does not complete their usual call and response.
timeline.quote: Reyana had not spoken her half of their usual call and response

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Reyana is gone in the morning, leaving only a note to meet at the Salvage Complex.
timeline.quote: Meet me at the Salvage Complex.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: They find Reyana shackled in the Salvage Complex's pit among rows of kneeling dead Phyrexians, apparently unguarded.
timeline.quote: it was Reyana, shackled and prone.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Neyali descends with Saheena and her sons, and Reyana frees herself from her chains and is revealed as a willing traitor.
timeline.quote: Reyana, no longer bound, sat up placidly

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Reyana says she wants the perfect peace her mother was given, and Slobad appears with an aspirant who is the father of Saheena's son.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Neyali is caged above as Slobad himself prepares to compleate Reyana.
timeline.quote: To Neyali's surprise, it was not a priest who came to begin Reyana's transformation but Slobad himself.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Neyali rallies the freed Mirrans and offers Reyana a hand, but Reyana turns away as Neyali leads her people out.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: After a Phyrexian massacre decimates her village, Reyana wanders the ruins of Mirrex alone until Neyali and Otharri find her and integrate her into their cell.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Neyali and her firebird Otharri eventually found and integrated Reyana into their resistance cell.

citation.text: "Reyana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Quiet Furnace Reyana faces her mother, now a Phyrexian aspirant, abandons her weapons and despairs; Neyali's intervention saves her.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Neyali's intervention saved her physically, but the emotional scars remained.

citation.text: "Reyana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torn by longing for peace, Reyana leaves a note and disappears; the others search for her.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: This inner turmoil drove her to leave a note and disappear

citation.text: "Reyana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Salvage Complex Reyana's betrayal is revealed: she willingly seeks compleation promised by Slobad.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

citation.text: "Reyana", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Childhood friends who call each other family; Reyana betrays her.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

pages_say.description: An Auriok woman and Neyali's childhood friend, who raises firebirds and is shaken by her compleated mother; she goes willingly to Slobad seeking peace.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Cinders" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.
